findings.title: Container calls the API server with a token for another audience
findings.cause: container sync exits because the API server refuses its token (401 Unauthorized, not a missing permission): the token at /var/run/secrets/tokens/vault-token, from projected volume vault-token, is minted for audience vault, and the API server accepts only tokens minted for its own; its log says: "wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized"; Deployment sync has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container sync exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 7 times
last lines of container sync's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
listing pods
wget: note: TLS certificate validation not implemented
wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized

evidence.what: volume vault-token projects a ServiceAccount token for audience vault at /var/run/secrets/tokens/vault-token

findings.fix: Call the API server with a token for its own audience: the default one at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token (automounted unless turned off), or a projected token with no audience. Keep the vault token for vault.
